_comment: Nominal whoop and plate parameters shared by the simulator (sim/) and the identification tests (sysid/). Assumptions until the drone is weighed and identified: a 75 mm whoop of about 30 g (BetaFPV Meteor75 Pro class), L2F conventions (body x forward, y left, z up; thrust along +z; normalized motor command u in [0, 1]).

whoop._thrust: thrust per rotor [N] = c0 + c1 u + c2 u^2: about 0.3 N per rotor at full command, thrust-to-weight about 4 [assumption]
whoop._torque: yaw torque per rotor [N m] = rotor_torque_constant x thrust [assumption, Crazyflie order of magnitude]
whoop._time_constants: first-order lag of the normalized motor state u, rising constant when the command is above the state, falling otherwise, as L2F (70_post_integration.h); thrust follows from the lagged u [s] [assumption]
whoop._J: inertia [kg m^2], diagonal [assumption, scaled from the Crazyflie]

plate._comment: Vertical 3 mm EPP sheet under the frame, in the body x-z plane; model of research/flat_plate_aero.md section 1.5, Model B (saturating normal force) plus in-plane friction
plate._added_mass: mass of the plate itself [kg]; with the plate the vehicle weighs mass + added_mass and the plate inertia is added to J
